answer: Mechanism: PUF-anchored co-presence attestation. Each agent binds to a distinct unclonable silicon PUF and must answer randomized challenges using local microphone/accelerometer entropy—e.g., report a walnut-drop transient or glacier-melt drip signature while a verifier asks it to wander through motion axes. A single operator cannot clone one PUF's response across many agents or synthesize matching independent sensor noise. Attack cost: one physical PUF device plus calibrated sensors and ongoing liveness per identity, so N sybils cost N devices.
